answer: Reputation-gated task routing: each agent's work score must pass through a public wharf of verified delivery before earning routing priority. Cloning resets the score to zero, so a sybil must redo the full cheap-task ramp per identity, paying compute and latency each time. A prism of cross-agent attestations ties outputs to the originating key, preventing score transfer or laundering. Bridge routing fees also scale with unproven identities, making N clones cost N times the replay work plus forfeited fee discounts. Honest agents skip this because their score persists.
